question: How many judgments does the legal graph hold?
paraphrases: How many Supreme Court judgments are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) RETURN count(c) AS judgments

question: How many judge names does the graph record?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge) RETURN count(j) AS judges

question: How many different law names (acts and codes) does the graph record?
cypher: MATCH (a:Act) RETURN count(a) AS laws

question: How many different parties appear in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (p:Party) RETURN count(p) AS parties

question: How many distinct subject topics are judgments tagged with?
cypher: MATCH (t:Topic) RETURN count(t) AS topics

question: How many topics fall in each topic category?
paraphrases: Break the topics down by category.
cypher: MATCH (t:Topic) RETURN t.category AS category, count(*) AS topics ORDER BY topics DESC, category

question: How many judgments were delivered in each month of 2016?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE c.year = 2016 RETURN c.month AS month, count(*) AS judgments ORDER BY month

question: Which judgment in the graph is dated 2017 rather than 2016?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE c.year = 2017 RETURN c.title AS judgment

question: How many judgments have no title recorded?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE c.title IS NULL RETURN count(c) AS untitled

question: Which judge decided the most judgments?
paraphrases: Who was the busiest judge in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case) WITH j, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN j.name AS judge, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, judge LIMIT 1

question: How many judgments did Justice {judge} decide?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge {name: $judge})-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments

question: How many judgments were delivered in month {month} of 2016 (1 = January)?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE c.year = 2016 AND c.month = $month RETURN count(c) AS judgments

question: How many judgments cite the {act}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[:CITES]->(a:Act {name: $act}) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments

question: How many topics belong to the {category} category?
cypher: MATCH (t:Topic {category: $category}) RETURN count(t) AS topics

question: In how many judgments is {party} a party?
cypher: MATCH (p:Party {name: $party})-[:PARTY_IN]->(c:Case) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments

question: Which ten judges decided the most judgments?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case) WITH j, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN j.name AS judge, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, judge LIMIT 10

question: Which ten laws are cited in the most judgments?
paraphrases: Which statutes does the Court cite most often?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[:CITES]->(a:Act) WITH a, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN a.name AS law, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, law LIMIT 10

question: Which ten provisions (law plus section) are cited in the most judgments?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[r:CITES]->(a:Act) WITH a.name AS law, r.section AS section, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN law, section, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, law, section LIMIT 10

question: How many judgments cite section {section} of the {act}?
paraphrases: In how many judgments is section {section} of the {act} invoked?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[r:CITES]->(a:Act {name: $act}) WHERE r.section = $section RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments

question: Which judges decided the case {title}?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case {title: $title}) RETURN j.name AS judge ORDER BY judge

params.name: title
params.sample: SUKH RAM v. STATE OF HIMACHAL PRADESH

question: Which laws and sections does the judgment in {title} cite?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case {title: $title})-[r:CITES]->(a:Act) RETURN a.name AS law, r.section AS section ORDER BY law, section

params.name: title
params.sample: SUKH RAM v. STATE OF HIMACHAL PRADESH

question: What topics is the judgment in {title} tagged with, and in which category is each?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case {title: $title})-[:ABOUT]->(t:Topic) RETURN t.text AS topic, t.category AS category ORDER BY topic

params.name: title
params.sample: SUKH RAM v. STATE OF HIMACHAL PRADESH

question: Who were the parties in {title}, and what role did each play?
cypher: MATCH (p:Party)-[r:PARTY_IN]->(c:Case {title: $title}) RETURN p.name AS party, r.role AS role ORDER BY party

params.name: title
params.sample: SUKH RAM v. STATE OF HIMACHAL PRADESH

question: With which five judges did {judge} sit most often?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge {name: $judge})-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)<-[:DECIDED]-(o:Judge) WITH o, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN o.name AS judge, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, judge LIMIT 5

question: Which six laws are cited most often in judgments decided by {judge}?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge {name: $judge})-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)-[:CITES]->(a:Act) WITH a, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN a.name AS law, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, law LIMIT 6

question: Across the judgments decided by {judge}, how many touch each topic category?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge {name: $judge})-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(t:Topic) WITH t.category AS category, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN category, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, category

question: In each month, how many judgments did {judge} deliver?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge {name: $judge})-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case) WITH c.year AS year, c.month AS month, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN year, month, judgments ORDER BY year, month

question: Which ten sections of the {act} are cited in the most judgments?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[r:CITES]->(a:Act {name: $act}) WITH r.section AS section, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN section, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, section LIMIT 10

question: How many different sections of the {act} are cited across all judgments?
cypher: MATCH (:Case)-[r:CITES]->(a:Act {name: $act}) RETURN count(DISTINCT r.section) AS sections

question: In how many judgments does {party} appear in each role, ignoring capitalisation of the role?
paraphrases: How often was {party} the appellant and how often the respondent?
cypher: MATCH (p:Party {name: $party})-[r:PARTY_IN]->(c:Case) WITH toLower(r.role) AS role, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN role, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, role

question: Across all judgments, how many party appearances are there in each role, ignoring capitalisation?
cypher: MATCH (:Party)-[r:PARTY_IN]->(:Case) WITH toLower(r.role) AS role, count(*) AS appearances RETURN role, appearances ORDER BY appearances DESC, role

question: Which parties appear in at least 10 judgments, and in how many each?
cypher: MATCH (p:Party)-[:PARTY_IN]->(c:Case) WITH p, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments WHERE judgments >= 10 RETURN p.name AS party, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, party

question: Among judgments with at least one judge recorded, how many were decided by benches of each size?
paraphrases: How common are two-judge, three-judge and larger benches?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case) WITH c, count(DISTINCT j) AS bench RETURN bench, count(*) AS judgments ORDER BY bench

question: Which judgment had the largest bench, and how many judges sat on it?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case) WITH c, count(DISTINCT j) AS bench RETURN c.title AS judgment, bench ORDER BY bench DESC, judgment LIMIT 1

question: How many judgments have no judge recorded?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE NOT (c)<-[:DECIDED]-(:Judge) RETURN count(c) AS judgments

question: How many judgments do not cite any law?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE NOT (c)-[:CITES]->(:Act) RETURN count(c) AS judgments

question: Which month of 2016 saw the most judgments delivered?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE c.year = 2016 WITH c.month AS month, count(*) AS judgments RETURN month, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, month LIMIT 1

question: Which ten topics are attached to the most judgments?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(t:Topic) WITH t, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN t.text AS topic, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, topic LIMIT 10

question: How many distinct judgments touch each topic category?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(t:Topic) WITH t.category AS category, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN category, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, category

question: Which judgments are tagged with the topic {topic}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(t:Topic {text: $topic}) RETURN c.title AS judgment ORDER BY judgment

question: Which five judges decided the most judgments with a {category} topic?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(:Topic {category: $category}) WITH j, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN j.name AS judge, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, judge LIMIT 5

question: How many parties appear in more than one judgment?
cypher: MATCH (p:Party)-[:PARTY_IN]->(c:Case) WITH p, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments WHERE judgments > 1 RETURN count(p) AS parties

question: Which ten pairs of judges sat together on the most judgments?
cypher: MATCH (j1:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)<-[:DECIDED]-(j2:Judge) WHERE j1.name < j2.name WITH j1.name AS judge_a, j2.name AS judge_b, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN judge_a, judge_b, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, judge_a, judge_b LIMIT 10

question: On how many judgments did {judge_a} and {judge_b} sit together?
cypher: MATCH (a:Judge {name: $judge_a})-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)<-[:DECIDED]-(b:Judge {name: $judge_b}) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments

question: Which ten pairs of laws are most often cited in the same judgment?
cypher: MATCH (a1:Act)<-[:CITES]-(c:Case)-[:CITES]->(a2:Act) WHERE a1.name < a2.name WITH a1.name AS law_a, a2.name AS law_b, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN law_a, law_b, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, law_a, law_b LIMIT 10

question: Which ten laws are cited in judgments spanning the most topic categories?
cypher: MATCH (a:Act)<-[:CITES]-(c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(t:Topic) WITH a, count(DISTINCT t.category) AS categories, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN a.name AS law, categories, judgments ORDER BY categories DESC, judgments DESC, law LIMIT 10

question: Which six laws are cited most often in judgments with a {category} topic?
cypher: MATCH (a:Act)<-[:CITES]-(c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(:Topic {category: $category}) WITH a, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN a.name AS law, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, law LIMIT 6

question: Which judges decided at least 8 judgments citing section {section} of the {act}, and how many each?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)-[r:CITES]->(:Act {name: $act}) WHERE r.section = $section WITH j, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments WHERE judgments >= 8 RETURN j.name AS judge, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, judge

question: Which three judges most often heard judgments involving {party}?
cypher: MATCH (:Party {name: $party})-[:PARTY_IN]->(c:Case)<-[:DECIDED]-(j:Judge) WITH j, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN j.name AS judge, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, judge LIMIT 3

question: How many judgments involving {party} did {judge} decide?
cypher: MATCH (:Party {name: $party})-[:PARTY_IN]->(c:Case)<-[:DECIDED]-(:Judge {name: $judge}) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments

question: Which five other sections of the {act} are most often cited in the same judgment as section {section}?
cypher: MATCH (a:Act {name: $act})<-[r1:CITES]-(c:Case)-[r2:CITES]->(a) WHERE r1.section = $section AND r2.section <> $section WITH r2.section AS section, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN section, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, section LIMIT 5

question: Which four other topics are most often tagged on the same judgments as {topic}?
cypher: MATCH (:Topic {text: $topic})<-[:ABOUT]-(c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(o:Topic) WHERE o.text <> $topic WITH o, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN o.text AS topic, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, topic LIMIT 4

question: Which five judges decided judgments citing the widest range of different laws?
cypher: MATCH (j:Judge)-[:DECIDED]->(c:Case)-[:CITES]->(a:Act) WITH j, count(DISTINCT a) AS laws RETURN j.name AS judge, laws ORDER BY laws DESC, judge LIMIT 5

question: Which five pairs of topic categories most often appear together on the same judgment?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Topic)<-[:ABOUT]-(c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(t2:Topic) WHERE t1.category < t2.category WITH t1.category AS category_a, t2.category AS category_b, count(DISTINCT c) AS judgments RETURN category_a, category_b, judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC, category_a, category_b LIMIT 5

question: How many appeals were allowed and how many dismissed?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE c.outcome IS NOT NULL RETURN c.outcome AS outcome, count(*) AS judgments ORDER BY judgments DESC

question: Which advocate argued the most cases before the Court?
cypher: MATCH (a:Advocate)-[:ARGUED]->(c:Case) RETURN a.name AS advocate, count(DISTINCT c) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC, advocate LIMIT 1

question: Which High Court did the most appeals come from?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case) WHERE c.lower_court IS NOT NULL RETURN c.lower_court AS court, count(*) AS appeals ORDER BY appeals DESC, court LIMIT 1

question: How many days passed between filing and judgment in {title}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case {title: $title}) WHERE c.filed_date IS NOT NULL AND c.decided_date IS NOT NULL RETURN c.filed_date AS filed, c.decided_date AS decided

params.name: title
params.sample: SUKH RAM v. STATE OF HIMACHAL PRADESH
